scope: Applied gas-pedal demand, not measured acceleration or percent engine power. Every car is measured over its own complete spatial section. Groups use time-weighted car-seconds; preview is also included in club and field.
precision: 10 Hz observations held to the next sample, clipped at interpolated spatial gates. Approximate exposure, not physics-tick pedal integration. Full throttle >=95%, partial >5%, coast -1% to 5%, braking <-1%. Average throttle includes zero during coast/brake.
interpretation: No target of 100% everywhere: traffic occupancy, speed limits, grip and braking distance must still be respected. The last 80 m is reported separately because corner preparation may legitimately require braking.
